desc:
Boosted Legends 🔧🏁

Build your dream engine from the ground up! Choose from a huge selection of aftermarket parts, customize your setup, adjust your stroke, and push your horsepower to the limit.

🔩 Build It Your Way — Mix and match engine blocks, cylinder heads, crankshafts, pistons, and more.

⚙️ Full Engine Tuning — Customize your engine setup to create the perfect build.

💨 Chase Big Horsepower — Start with a street build and work your way up to insane 2,000+ HP and beyond.

🏎️ Create Your Dream Build — Experiment with different combinations and see how much power you can make.

🔥 No Limits. Just Horsepower. Build it, tune it, and unleash the beast!

Can you build the ultimate engine?
